title: A pilot's life
instructions: Pilot Clara mesleğini anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; sayıları, sıklıkları ve sevdiği/sevmediği şeyleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: clara
script.text: I'm Clara, and I've been a pilot for twelve years. Now I'm a captain.

script.speaker: clara
script.text: I wanted to fly since I was a little girl. My father worked at an airport, and I loved watching the planes.

script.speaker: clara
script.text: Training was long and expensive. It took nearly three years.

script.speaker: clara
script.text: Now I mostly fly short flights in Europe, to cities like Paris, Rome and Lisbon.

script.speaker: clara
script.text: On a normal day, I fly four flights and come home in the evening.

script.speaker: clara
script.text: I usually work five days, then I have four days off.

script.speaker: clara
script.text: The best part is the view. Sunrises above the clouds are amazing.

script.speaker: clara
script.text: The worst part is getting up early. Sometimes I start work at four in the morning!

script.speaker: clara
script.text: People think pilots visit lots of cities, but usually I only see the airport.

script.speaker: clara
script.text: Next year, I hope to fly long flights to Asia.

questions.prompt: How long has Clara been a pilot?
questions.feedback: On iki yıldır pilot. Üç yıl eğitim süresi.
questions.evidence: I've been a pilot for twelve years.

questions.prompt: Why did Clara want to be a pilot?
options: She loved watching planes at the airport.
She wanted to see the world.
Pilots earn a lot of money.
questions.feedback: Babası havalimanında çalışıyordu; uçakları izlemeyi severdi.
questions.evidence: and I loved watching the planes.

questions.prompt: How many days off does she usually have?
questions.feedback: Genelde beş gün çalışıp dört gün izin yapıyor.
questions.evidence: then I have four days off.

questions.prompt: What is the worst part of her job?
questions.evidence: The worst part is getting up early.

questions.prompt: What does Clara hope to do next year?
questions.feedback: Gelecek yıl Asya'ya uzun uçuşlar yapmayı umuyor.
questions.evidence: Next year, I hope to fly long flights to Asia.
